Name: OD's Cooking Plus
Author: ODMods
Description:
[size=6]OD's Cooking Plus[/size]
[b]Author:[/b] OD Mods 
[b]Version:[/b] 1.0.0 
[b]SMAPI:[/b] 4.x 
[b]Game:[/b] Stardew Valley 1.6
[line]

[size=4]What It Does[/size]

Every time you cook a recipe at the kitchen, a sequence of skill-based minigames kicks in before the food is added to your inventory. A [b]quantity selector[/b] lets you choose how many to cook upfront — the minigames run once and the bonus applies to the whole batch. How well you perform directly affects the item's [b]energy and health restoration[/b], and perfect scores can permanently boost your [b]Max Energy[/b].
[line]

[size=4]Minigames[/size]

| Minigame | Mechanic | Controls |
|---|---|---|
| [b]Frying[/b] | Keep temperature needle in the green sweet-spot zone | SPACE / Click to toggle heat |
| [b]Chopping[/b] | Press when the sliding knife is over a highlighted zone | SPACE / Click to chop |
| [b]Bowl Assembly[/b] | Click falling ingredients in the correct recipe order | Click |
| [b]Stirring[/b] | Move mouse in circular motion inside the pot | Mouse movement |
| [b]Baking[/b] | Press at the perfect moment as the baking bar fills | SPACE / Click to open oven |
| [b]Seasoning[/b] | Tap to add seasoning; commit when the meter is in the green zone | SPACE to shake, E/Enter to commit |
| [b]Grinding[/b] | Click ingredients in the correct order as they scroll past | Click |
| [b]Rolling[/b] | Guide a rolling pin back and forth; press when over textured sections | A/D or ←/→ to move, SPACE to press |
| [b]Kneading[/b] | Press when the sinusoidal marker is inside the narrowing sweet spot | SPACE |
| [b]Catching[/b] | Move the pot left/right to catch falling ingredients | A/D or ←/→ |
| [b]Simmering[/b] | Click when the temperature needle is in the ideal zone on a vertical gauge | Click |
| [b]Plating[/b] | Drag ingredient sprites onto target circles on the plate | Drag & drop |

Different recipes trigger different combinations of minigames based on how they're cooked (60+ recipes mapped).
[line]

[size=4]Quantity Selection[/size]

When you cook, a quantity selector appears before the minigames:
- Click [b]+[/b] / [b]-[/b] buttons to adjust
- Type a number directly with [b]0–9[/b] keys
- [b]Backspace[/b] to clear, [b]Enter[/b] to confirm, [b]Esc[/b] to cook 1
- Extra batch ingredients are consumed from inventory after the minigames complete
[line]

[size=4]Scoring & Grades[/size]

| Grade | Score % | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| ⭐ Perfect | 100% | ×1.5 energy/health + permanent +Max Energy bonus |
| Great | 85%+ | ×1.25 energy/health |
| Good | 65%+ | ×1.10 energy/health |
| Okay | 45%+ | ×1.00 energy/health (base) |
| Poor | 25%+ | ×0.75 energy/health |
| Burnt | <25% | ×0.40 energy/health |

The [b]+ Max Energy[/b] bonus on Perfect cooks is permanent and stacks across multiple perfect cooks (configurable, default +10 per perfect). Bonus-grade foods also show [b]quality stars[/b] (Silver, Gold, Iridium) as a visual indicator.
[line]

[size=4]Configuration[/size]

Open the in-game menu → Mod Options (requires Generic Mod Config Menu (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098)):

- [b]Enable Minigames[/b] – master on/off toggle
- [b]Difficulty Multiplier[/b] – 0.5× (easier) to 3.0× (harder); affects speed and zone sizes
- [b]Perfect Gives Max Energy[/b] – enable/disable the permanent bonus
- [b]Max Energy Bonus[/b] – how much Max Energy a perfect cook adds (default 10)
- [b]Play Sounds[/b] – toggle sound effects

You can also edit `config.json` directly in the mod folder.
[line]

[size=4]Installation[/size]

1. Install [SMAPI](https://smapi.io/) 4.x.
2. Drop the `ODsCookingPlus` folder into your `Mods` directory.
3. Launch the game via SMAPI.
[line]

[size=4]Compatibility[/size]

- Works with any mod that adds new cooking recipes — the system falls back to a sensible default minigame set for unrecognised foods.
- Compatible with cooking-skill mods; the edibility multiplier is applied on top of whatever base value the item has.
- Not compatible with mods that completely replace the cooking UI (e.g. mods that remove `CraftingPage` entirely).
- Requires SDV 1.6 / SMAPI 4.x.
[line]
